description: Runs the jet filtration forward with the corpus's own M_n = z = A-1 and Vol_A. It reproduces the A=3 pair it was read off from (0.16% and 3.0%), supplies only 39.7% of 4He (the rest is the 2.51889 magic-shell factor), is degenerate at A=2 (Vol(Hopf) = 0 exactly), and CANNOT RUN at A>=5 because binding_link_volumes assigns links only up to 4He and no nucleus->knot accessor covers A>=5. Every point where it runs was used to set it: ZERO out-of-sample support, a worse shape than qou-ebs6's one-parameter-two-points. Scope-(a): nothing refuted; the route is untestable until Vol_A extends past A=4.

why_A5_and_beyond_cannot_run.requirement: Vol_A needs a per-nucleus link assignment
why_A5_and_beyond_cannot_run.what_exists: binding_link_volumes.py: 2H Hopf (Vol=0), 3H 8_11, 3He L6a4, 4He 'L6a4 base'. Nothing above A=4.
why_A5_and_beyond_cannot_run.what_does_not: no nucleus->knot accessor for A>=5 found; the knot-periodic-table appendix is KNOT-indexed, not nucleus-indexed, so it does not supply one

out_of_sample_support.used_for_calibration: 2 at A=3 fix the multiplicity; 1 at A=4 fixes the 2.51889 enhancement
out_of_sample_support.comparison: strictly worse than bean qou-ebs6's recorded 'one parameter, two points, zero out-of-sample support' -- here 2.52 is one parameter against ONE point
out_of_sample_support.prerequisite: extending the per-nucleus link assignment past A=4 is the prerequisite for DECIDING any route here, not a side quest
